---
name: Feature Request / Reverse Engineering Finding
about: Propose a new feature or share a newly discovered wire-format field
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Summary

A clear and concise description of what you want to add or what you discovered.

## Motivation

Why is this useful? What use case does it enable?

## Proposed Approach

If you have a concrete proposal, describe it here. Reference relevant source files (e.g. `wire.py`, `stroke.py`) and protobuf field numbers if known.

## Evidence / Sample

If this is a reverse-engineering finding, please provide:

- The archive member path (e.g. `notes/<UUID>`)
- The protobuf field numbers involved
- A representative hex dump or JSON wire tree snippet

> **Do not attach files containing personal data.**

## Alternatives Considered

Any other approaches you considered and why you chose this one.
